title: OA EXPLANATION OF YEARLY EVENTS - the nineteen event explanations: the ambassadors and assassinations, the disasters and wars, with their durations, chances and price effects
audit_label: R698 OA yearly events prose audit
audit_comment: OA round eighty-five (capture pp. 240-243): the Explanation of Yearly Events - the nineteen Table 71 events explained with their durations, chances and effects, plus the never-rerolled rule, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA EXPLANATION OF YEARLY EVENTS, printed capture pp. 240-243 - the yearly explanations round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE RIGIDITY: the events not accounting for the player characters, the outcomes changeable, but the yearly event NEVER rerolled - prevented meaning no yearly event for the year; the season check after the month roll. THE EXPLANATIONS: the Ambassador of the 50/50 direction staying 3d10 months, the 10% gaijin, the court ceremonies; the Assassination with the 30% taken-alive, the 1% accusation, the 20% succession struggle and the 1d6-month turmoil; the Birth celebrated for days; the Comet of the 1d4 weeks, the portent, the DM's second event to follow; the Death of a Lord with the Assassination's succession; the Major Earthquake of the 50-mile radius, the 70% fire and the 40% plague, the earthquake spell effects, the few hours; the Famine of the 2-7 months, the food at 10 to 100 times, the 25% next-year income, the 60% uprising, the 5% monthly population loss, the 20% plague; the Major Fire of the 50% to 80% city, the 10% to 40% population, the 20% plague, the 10% famine, the 10x lumber for four months, the doubled food for one; the Flood of the 5d6-foot crest, the half foot per hour, the 4d6-hour high, the signs 2-5 days ahead, the dikes, the 50% planting-season and 80% harvest losses, the 40% famine, the 20% plague, no deserts; the Major Incursion of the 1d12 months, proportionate, remaining until driven out; the Marriage diplomatic and festive; the New Religion with the 75% hostility, the 60% ruler's favor, the 40% ban, the 2-7 month arrival, the feuds of centuries; the Plague of the 2d6 months, the 40% and 60% contagion, the 5% monthly loss, the 5x imports, the moving scythe; the Political Plot with the 40% and 80% accusations, the 20% noble rising, the 1-3 month turmoil; the Rebellion of the 1d6 months, the BATTLESYSTEM recommendation, no mercy for the captured; the Tsunami of the 50-mile coast, the 100-200 feet, the 70% population loss, the landlocked no-event, the 10% plague, the 3x building materials; the Visitation of the revered pilgrim site or the despised 5-mile shunning; the Volcano of the 70/30 origin, the 5-mile destruction, the 30-mile ash, the 1d12-month activity, the 10% monthly re-eruption; the War of the 50/50 direction, the 2-5 month campaign in the summer, the 1-3 years, the 50% farm loss, the press gangs. The explanations codify per the R431 calculus

bools.name: djlAmbassadorEitherDirection
bools.comment: the Ambassador direction - arriving from another land or sent to one, 50/50; sent to prevent war, form an alliance, arrange a marriage, pay tribute, promote trade or gain culture, the arrival a major court event of ceremonies and banquets (print capture p. 240)

bools.name: djlAssassinPcSuspicion
bools.comment: the Assassination suspicion - the player characters suspected as vassals or dealing partners of the slain, automatically if known enemies (print capture p. 240)

bools.name: djlAssassinStruggleMayWar
bools.comment: the Assassination power struggle - lasting 1d6 months and possibly resulting in war if the DM desires (print capture p. 240)

bools.name: djlBirthCelebration
bools.comment: the Birth - the noble line continued, the happy event with feasting and ceremonies lasting several days (print capture p. 240)

bools.name: djlCometPortentSecond
bools.comment: the Comet portent - the bright comet sighted 1d4 weeks, a portent of some great event: a second yearly event chosen by the DM and occurring shortly after the comet passes (print capture p. 240)

bools.name: djlDeathSameAsAssassination
bools.comment: the Death of a Lord - the noble dying in battle, misadventure, disease or peacefully in bed, the succession effects the same as the Assassination's (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlQuakeLesserTremors
bools.comment: the Major Earthquake tremors - the series of lesser tremors before and after, slight damage per the DM (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlQuakeSpellEffects
bools.comment: the Major Earthquake effects - the player characters and property in the radius affected as by an earthquake spell, the severity the DM's choice; the quake lasting only a few hours, destroying cities and reshaping lakes, coastlines and rivers (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlFamineSigns
bools.comment: the Famine signs - the crops withering, animals dying, the poor hungering; the marauder groups scavenging for food of any type (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlFirePcPropertyBurned
bools.comment: the Major Fire property - the player characters' property burned to the ground at the percentage chance equal to the amount of the city destroyed (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlFloodLevees
bools.comment: the Flood warning - the signs obvious 2-5 days in advance, the levees and dikes buildable to protect against the rising waters (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlFloodNoDesert
bools.comment: the Flood limit - floods never occurring in desert or arid regions (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlIncursionProportionate
bools.comment: the Major Incursion scale - the migration in proportion to the kingdom, the several hundred creatures of a small province or the several thousand of a large kingdom; humans, humanoids or monsters, not necessarily war (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlIncursionRemainsUntilDrivenOut
bools.comment: the Major Incursion settlement - the creatures remaining until driven out, the old habits and language retained, gradually adopted into the regular part of life if allowed to stay (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlMarriageDiplomatic
bools.comment: the Marriage - the ruler's important diplomatic marriage of himself or his children, securing alliances, controlling smaller kingdoms, settling disputes or appeasing overlords; festivals and feasting (print capture p. 241)

bools.name: djlNewReligionRulersTool
bools.comment: the New Religion politics - the rulers supporting the new religions as a tool for breaking the political power of the established ones, both sides seeking the ruler's support (print capture p. 242)

bools.name: djlPlagueSweeps
bools.comment: the Plague movement - not the whole country at once but sweeping from town to town like a moving scythe: not yet hit, in the throes, or suffered and survived (print capture p. 242)

bools.name: djlPlotProveInnocence
bools.comment: the Political Plot justice - the accused proving innocence or suffering the consequences, the nobles stripped of rank, banished or executed (print capture p. 242)

bools.name: djlRebellionBattlesystem
bools.comment: the Rebellion battles - the BATTLESYSTEM supplement recommended for the military battles, the players managing the strategy of either side; the captured and defeated rebels expecting no mercy (print capture p. 242)

bools.name: djlTsunamiNoCoastNoEvent
bools.comment: the Tsunami limit - countries without coastlines treating the event as no event for the year (print capture p. 242)

bools.name: djlVisitationPaths
bools.comment: the Visitation - the major deity appearing for good or ill; the revered site becoming pilgrim and temple ground, the despised site shunned, the fortunes falling, the secret meeting place of evil followers and monsters (print capture p. 242)

bools.name: djlWarEitherDirection
bools.comment: the War direction - the ruler's campaign against a neighboring land or the invasion from one, 50/50; the causes, forces and outcome the DM's (print capture p. 243)

bools.name: djlWarPcRoles
bools.comment: the War player characters - readily accepted into the ranks, quickly rising in rank per their actions, possibly given commands with the BATTLESYSTEM supplement (print capture p. 243)

bools.name: djlWarHomefront
bools.comment: the War home front - away from the front the rebellion or uprising, the press gangs roaming, the younger sons deserting for soldier's fame, the civilians moving away (print capture p. 243)

bools.name: djlYearlyNeverRerolled
bools.comment: the event rigidity - the events not accounting for the player characters' actions; the player characters may change the outcomes but the YEARLY event is never rerolled (print capture p. 240)

bools.name: djlYearlyPreventedNone
bools.comment: the prevented yearly event - if the player characters manage to prevent it, no yearly event occurs for that year; the monthly events simply rerolled or decided when changed (print capture p. 240)

bools.name: djlYearlySeasonCheck
bools.comment: the season check - the exact description of the event giving the range of time over which it occurs, the monthly events checked for after the yearly month is determined (print capture p. 238)
